core.instructions: How well do the required core skills match the candidate's core stack: {{core_skills}}?
criteria: No match: none of candidate core skills are required
Weak match: adjacent tech stack with small overlap
Good match: requires candidate core skills plus minor others
Perfect match: candidate core skills are the primary requirement

tools.instructions: How many of the candidate preferred tools ({{tools}}) are covered?

contract.instructions: How well do contract type and seniority fit the preference (Seniority: {{seniority}}, wanted: {{contract_type}})?

pay.instructions: Given any compensation info, how attractive is it? (If missing, choose Not stated)

location.instructions: Which workplace arrangement applies to this job?

criteria.primary: Onsite or hybrid in candidate primary area ({{primary_location}})
criteria.remote: Fully remote (from home / anywhere in Italy)
criteria.hybrid: Hybrid with flexible attendance or close to {{primary_location}}
criteria.elsewhere: Onsite outside candidate area and not remote
criteria.unknown: No location or arrangement info available
